attendance_policy: Attendance is equally important which may be directly / indirectly related to grading.
makeup_policy: Make-Ups are not given as a routine. It is solely dependent upon the GENUINENESS OF THE CIRCUMSTANCES under which a student fails to appear in a scheduled evaluation component. In such circumstances, prior permission should be obtained from the Instructor-in- Charge. In no case the make-up letter be slipped inside the chamber of the Instructor-In-Charge or intimation sent after the evaluative (applicable only for mid-sem. test and comprehensive examination). The decision of the Instructor- in-Charge in these aspects will be final. No messaging or mails will be entertained as students being residential on campus, can met the I/C of the course, in terms of any difficulty.
